messages:
jae: quick note — kicked off a bring-up for cinder-v2 embeddings. did a fast smoke on wiki-holdout (5k queries) and saw a small drop vs beacon-v2. posting the short findings and next steps. :eyes:
marie: can you drop the raw numbers and exact eval flags?
jae: short table below:
```
baseline: beacon-v2 fp16    recall@5 = 0.605
cinder-v2 fp16              recall@5 = 0.594  (-0.011)
cinder-v2 int8 per-tensor  recall@5 = 0.586  (-0.019)
cinder-v2 int8 per-channel recall@5 = 0.592  (-0.013)
NDCG@10 baseline 0.687 -> cinder-v2-fp16 0.676
avg pos cosine: baseline 0.74 -> cinder-v2 0.71
```
flags: `--norm cosine --holdout wiki --k 5 --seed 7` vectors saved L2-normalized for cosine run. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/cinder/v2/quick/
tony: interesting that per-channel narrows the gap vs per-tensor int8. did you run centering/whitening postproc?
jae: ran a simple mean-centering (subtract global index mean then renorm) -> fp16 recall@5 -> 0.600, per-channel int8 -> 0.597. helps but not fully.
lina: cohort breakdown? short vs long? language breakdown?
jae: shortseq (<6 tokens) is where most loss is — recall@5 down ~3.8% abs. long queries stable. english dominates the shortseq signal.
marie: are positives disappearing or just ranking lower? top1 overlap numbers?
jae: ran topk-overlap: baseline vs cinder-v2 top1 overlap on shortseq: 0.86 -> 0.74 (more id-flips). top5 overlap went 0.95 -> 0.90. so both rank and id movement.
tony: did you plot embedding norms / variance? pooling tweak could change magnitude distrib.
jae: yes — cinder-v2 shows wider norm spread, mean slightly lower. UMAP on 2k shortseq queries shows more spread / less tight clusters. gist: https://gist.github.com/jae/cinder-v2-umap-sample
marie: sounds like pooling+ln change. what changed in cinder-v2 arch compared to beacon?
jae: small change: switched from avg-pool to attentive-pool (lightweight) and moved final LN after projection. small but could shift center.
lina: let's run two ablations: 1) revert LN placement 2) revert pooling back to avg. also try PCA-whiten indexing as a quick mitigation.
jae: plan: (A) per-channel/int8 calibration sweep (symmetric vs asym, clip methods) (B) ablation runs (LN-back, pool-back) (C) whitening+re-eval on cohorts (D) generate 50 failure cases for model authors. kicking jobs now.
ci-bot: nightly-eval triggered: job cinder-v2-onboard-20260403-01. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/cinder-v2-onboard-20260403-01/logs. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/cinder/v2/case-examples.zip
marie: once you have the ablation numbers, please include the id-flip matrix and a tiny csv of examples (query, gt-id, new-rank) — that'll help root cause quickly.
jae: will do. ETA ~1h for first batch. ping here when done. thanks all :thumbsup:
